title: The verdict of reporters Goddess Anggraini
paragraphs: The verdict has been made on the news of a lie against the journalist in the news of Mine, the goddess Anggraini, has been read: the defendant has been released.
According to the charges, Goddess Anggraini published a report about the license of the nickel mines on October 5, 2025, which the prosecutor judged to broadcast a lie.
The House of Justice of the State Hammer Court reads the verdict on March 11, 2026, a complete copy of the verdict has not been published.
In the matter of Goddess Anggraini, Rina Susanti's legal counsel referred to it as being convicted without asking the expert opinion of the press board.
Goddess Anggraini works as a reporter for the News of Mine in Hammer, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The prosecutor and the defendant can still appeal, Goddess Anggraini is not under arrest.
